# Master Thumbnail Design System (v1.0)

**Purpose:** Enforce design rules for maximum CTR and mobile visibility
**Applies to:** All YouTube thumbnails generated by SEO Manager

---

# 1. Global Constraints (Apply to ALL Thumbnails) - UPDATED

## Distinctness Constraint & Anti-Duplication (NEW RULE) 🆕

**The "Three-Only" Rule:** When generating a set for A/B testing, the system must output exactly three images.

**Visual Uniqueness:** Each of the three images MUST be visually distinct from the others at a glance.
- The system is **PROHIBITED** from generating multiple images that are functionally identical
- Examples of violations: Only 1% difference in saturation, 5-pixel shift in text position
- **Minimum distinctness threshold:** Visual differences must be immediately obvious in YouTube search results

**Selection Protocol:** If a generative process creates multiple candidates for a single variation type (e.g., five "Vibrant Pop" images):
- Must automatically select the single best version
- Discard the rest
- Present final set of exactly three distinct variations

**Validation:** Before returning thumbnail set:
1. Verify exactly 3 images generated
2. Verify visual distinctness (color temperature, text treatment, or composition differ)
3. Verify no duplicates (fuzzy image comparison or metadata check)

---

## Safety Zones & UI Avoidance

**Bottom Right Quadrant (Dead Zone):** MUST remain empty of text and logos.
- **Why:** Reserved for YouTube timestamp overlay
- **Zone:** Right half (x > 640) AND bottom half (y > 360)

**The "Mobile Test":** Text size must be legible on a 360px wide screen.
- **Minimum font:** 80pt
- **Recommended:** 100-120pt

**Margins:** Keep all text and logos at least 40px from the edge of the canvas.

---

## Typography Standards

**Font Family:** Sans-serif, Extra Bold / Heavy
- Examples: Roboto Black, Montserrat ExtraBold, Impact, DejaVu Sans Bold

**Text Treatment:**
- **Color:** Pure White (#FFFFFF)
- **Contrast:** Heavy Black Stroke (Outline) 10-12px OR Hard Drop Shadow (Opacity 80%, Distance 10, Blur 10)
- **Max Word Count:** 4 words preferred. 5 words absolute maximum

---

## Image Quality

**Resolution:** 1280x720 (16:9 Aspect Ratio)

**Processing:**
- **Contrast:** +15% minimum (cut through atmospheric haze/screen glare)
- **Saturation:** +15-20% (enhance greens/blues for scenery)
- **Sharpening:** Mild unsharp mask applied to main subject

**Targets for a consuming pipeline** (this package does not apply them): contrast x1.17 on luma,
saturation x1.175 (clipping eats the two gains at different rates, so each gain should be stepped
independently), unsharp amount 0.5 / radius 1.0 (at 1920 wide). A finished frame should measure a
luma-contrast delta of +15..+25 % and a chroma delta of +15..+20 %. The pipeline that encodes and uploads the
frame should cap the JPEG at 2 MB, step quality 95 -> 90 -> 85, and refuse rather than upload an oversize
file. One-off enhancers with stronger boosts (saturation x1.4-1.8, contrast x1.2-1.5) are off-spec and must
not be used.
The Waypost generator (`seo_manager/youtube/thumbnail_generator.py`) does not read `video_path` yet; it adopts
the same finish once it takes a video frame.

# 1.5 A/B Testing Generation Protocol 🆕

## Crucial Rule for Sets of 3

**When generating a set of three thumbnails for a single video, they MUST NOT look identical.**

Apply the following **"Variation Schema"** across the three outputs to ensure distinct visual hooks:

### Variation A: The Anchor
- **Standard branding**
- Bright, saturated, clear text
- High visibility baseline

### Variation B: The Mood
- **Cinematic grading**
- Focus on lighting and atmosphere
- Deeper tones, not just brightness

### Variation C: The Hook
- **Typography focus**
- Secondary visual element
- Dual-text hierarchy or accent graphics

---

# 2. Mode A: "Immersion" (Scenic / POV) - UPDATED

**Use this schema for:** Driving tours, hiking videos, drone footage, travel vlogs

---

## Core Layout Composition (Shared across all variations)

**Subject Focus:** The "Road Ahead" or "Vantage Point" is the hero.
- Horizon line and vanishing point must be visible
- Road should occupy bottom 2/3 of frame

**Logo Placement:** Top Left preferred. Top Right acceptable as fallback.
- Size: 100-120px (small, unobtrusive)
- Must have adequate contrast to be visible

**Prohibited:**
- ❌ Do not place text in the center (blocks the road)
- ❌ Do not use solid background bars behind text (breaks immersion)
- ❌ Do not place logo in bottom half (distracts from scenery)

# 5. GENERATION PROTOCOL (STRICT ENFORCEMENT) 🆕

## Step 1: The Distinctness Check

When a request is made, generate three distinct **"Seeds"**:

1. **Seed A (Vibrant):** Focus on clarity, brightness, and legibility. *(The Safe Bet)*
2. **Seed B (Cinematic):** Change the time of day or weather condition. Focus on atmosphere. *(The Artistic Bet)*
3. **Seed C (Tactical):** Add a secondary visual element (Subtitle or Arrow). *(The Marketing Bet)*

---

## Step 2: The Anti-Duplication Filter

**Constraint:** Do not output intermediate steps or near-duplicates.

**Constraint:** If Seed A and Seed B look 90% similar, regenerate Seed B with "Stormy" or "Sunset" settings to force visual contrast.

**Visual Distance Test:** Before finalizing, compare the three images:
- If any two images share more than 80% visual similarity (same color grading + same text layout)
- Discard the weaker one
- Regenerate with extreme settings

**Self-Correction Loop:** If the system generates multiple options for "Variation A":
- Internally select the single best candidate
- Delete the others
- Present only the final choice

---

## Step 3: Final Output

Present exactly three files:
1. `[Filename]_VARIANT_A_VIBRANT.png`
2. `[Filename]_VARIANT_B_CINEMATIC.png`
3. `[Filename]_VARIANT_C_HOOK.png`

**No intermediate files. No duplicates. Exactly three distinct results.**

---

## Variation Guidelines (How to make them different) - EXTREME DEFINITIONS

### Variation A: The Anchor (Standard Brand)

**Prompting Logic:** "Daylight, Noon, Sunny, High Visibility"

**Goal:** Maximum eye-catching brightness - The "Safe" click

**Color:**
- **Saturation:** 120% (hyper-saturated)
- High Vibrance
- Grass: Lush green (vivid, almost neon)
- Sky: Bright blue/cyan (clear, vibrant)

**Lighting:**
- Midday, harsh, bright sun
- High contrast
- Clear, crisp shadows

**Text:**
- Single primary title only
- White (#FFFFFF) with **Hard Black Stroke** (12px)
- Placement: Top Center
- Font: 120pt
- NO subtitle, NO secondary elements

**Role:** The "Safe" click. This is the **control variable**.

**Example Result:**
```
Sky: Bright cyan blue (electric, clear)
Grass: Vivid green (#00FF00 territory)
Text: "KILKEE CLIFFS" (white, 12px hard black outline)
Mood: Energetic, inviting, "perfect day"
Processing: Sat +80-120%, Contrast +50%, Brightness +15%
```

---

### Variation B: The Mood (The "Drama" Shift)

**Prompting Logic:** "Stormy, Golden Hour, or Overcast" - Must differ from Variation A lighting

**Goal:** Feels like high-end movie; deeper colors - The "Artistic Bet"

**Color:**
- **Deep Blues, Dark Greens** (richer, not brighter)
- Vignette edges (darken periphery)
- Saturation: +40-60% (less than Variation A)
- Sky: **MUST look different than A** (if A is blue sky, B must be cloudy or golden)
- Grass: Forest green with depth, not neon

**Lighting:**
- **"Golden Hour"** (warm sunset glow) OR **Stormy** (dramatic clouds)
- Color Temperature Shift:
  - **Warm:** +20 to red/yellow channels (golden light on grass/road)
  - **Cool:** +20 to blue channel, -10 to red (dramatic storm)

**Composition:**
- Lower horizon slightly (road more dominant)
- **Vignette required** (draws eye to road)

**Text:**
- Single primary title
- White with **Soft Drop Shadow** (NOT hard outline)
- Shadow: Black, 80% opacity, 10px distance, 10px blur
- Feels "integrated with clouds/atmosphere"
- Placement: Top Center
- Font: 120pt

**CONSTRAINT:** The sky appearance MUST differ from Variation A:
- If A has clear blue sky → B must have clouds, golden tint, or storm
- If A is bright → B must be moody/atmospheric

**Example Result:**
```
Sky: Golden-tinted OR stormy clouds (NOT bright cyan like A)
Grass: Rich forest green with golden glow OR stormy shadows
Light: Golden hour warmth OR dramatic overcast
Text: "KILKEE CLIFFS" (white with soft shadow, blends with atmosphere)
Mood: Cinematic, dramatic, "epic journey"
Processing: Sat +40%, Warm tint +20%, Vignette applied
```

---

### Variation C: The Hook (The "Click-Bait" Element)

**Prompting Logic:** "High Contrast, Information Density"

**Goal:** Use text hierarchy or visual element to sell experience - The "Marketing Bet"

**Color & Light:**
- Standard bright grading (similar to Variation A)
- Vivid saturation (+70%)
- High contrast

**MANDATORY Secondary Element:** Must include ONE of:

**Option 1: Dual-Text Hierarchy (Recommended)**
- **Main Title:** "KILKEE CLIFFS" (White, 120pt, 12px black outline)
- **Sub-Title:** REQUIRED
  - Short, punchy descriptor (2-4 words)
  - Placed directly below main title
  - **50% smaller** font (60pt)
  - **Distinct color:** Bright Yellow/Gold (#FFD700) OR Electric Cyan (#00FFFF)
  - Heavy outline (6px)
  - **Examples:** "EPIC COASTAL DRIVE", "MUST SEE IRELAND", "DANGEROUS ROADS", "ATLANTIC VIEWS"

**Option 2: Visual Arrow/Graphic**
- Bright Red (#FF0000) or Yellow (#FFFF00) arrow
- Points to specific feature (cliffs, ocean, landmark)
- Thick stroke (8px), high visibility

**Placement:**
- Two-line text block OR single text + arrow
- Remains Top Center
- All elements within safe zone

**Role:** Catches the eye of skimmers who ignore standard titles

**Example Result:**
```
Main: "KILKEE CLIFFS" (white, 120pt, 12px outline)
Sub: "EPIC COASTAL DRIVE" (GOLD #FFD700, 60pt, 6px outline)
Mood: Exciting, sells the experience, clear value prop
Processing: Sat +70%, Contrast +40%, Brightness +10%
Secondary Element: MANDATORY (subtitle or arrow)
```

---

## Content Rules (Mode A: Immersion)

**Title Strategy:**
- Location Name (e.g., "KILKEE CLIFFS") > Descriptive Sentence
- Keep it short: 2-3 words ideal

**Vibe:**
- Escapism
- Clarity
- Hyper-reality (or cinematic drama for Variation B)

---

# 3. Mode B: "Authority" (Tech / Tutorials / Educational)

**Use this schema for:** DaVinci Resolve tutorials, AI/LLM guides, Hugo/Web Design

---

## Layout Composition

**Subject Focus:** Rule of Thirds
- The Subject (Face, Software Logo, or Hardware) goes in **Right Vertical Third** or **Left Vertical Third**
- NEVER dead center

**Text Placement:** Opposite the Subject (in the negative space)
- Example: Subject on Right → Text on Left (vertically centered)

**Logo Placement:** Top corner (opposite of subject) OR embedded on laptop screen/shirt

---

## Content Rules

**Visual Elements:**
- **Arrows:** Bright Yellow (#FFFF00) or Red (#FF0000) arrows pointing Text → Subject
- **Screenshots:** If showing software, zoom in 200% on specific tool/menu
- NEVER show full cluttered desktop

**Title Strategy:** Problem/Solution or Result
- ❌ Bad: "How to Edit in DaVinci"
- ✅ Good: "EDIT FASTER" or "FIX LAG"

**Vibe:** Utility, expertise, solution-oriented

---

# 4. Implementation Logic

```python
def generate_thumbnail_set(video_type, title, background_photo):
    """
    Generate 3 distinct variations for A/B testing
    """
    if video_type in ["drive", "hike", "scenic", "drone"]:
        mode = "Immersion"

        # Generate 3 distinct variations
        variant_a = apply_vibrant_pop(background_photo, title)
        variant_b = apply_cinematic_drama(background_photo, title)
        variant_c = apply_typography_hook(background_photo, title)

    elif video_type in ["tutorial", "coding", "tech"]:
        mode = "Authority"
        # Apply authority variations...

    # Validate all 3
    validate_against_global_constraints([variant_a, variant_b, variant_c])
    validate_visual_distinctness([variant_a, variant_b, variant_c])

    return [variant_a, variant_b, variant_c]
```

# 5. Validation Checklist

Before finalizing any thumbnail:

## Global Checks
- [ ] Bottom-right quadrant is empty
- [ ] All elements have 40px+ margins
- [ ] Text is 4 words or less (5 max)
- [ ] Font size ≥ 80pt (100-120pt recommended)
- [ ] Text is pure white (#FFFFFF)
- [ ] Outline is 10-12px thick
- [ ] Resolution is 1280x720

## Mode A: Immersion Checks
- [ ] Text is in top center (sky area)
- [ ] NO solid background bars
- [ ] Logo is in corner only
- [ ] Road/horizon visible
- [ ] Colors enhanced (+15% minimum)

## A/B Set Checks
- [ ] Variation A: Bright & saturated
- [ ] Variation B: Cinematic mood (warm/cool tint)
- [ ] Variation C: Dual-text with colored subtitle
- [ ] All 3 look visually distinct (not duplicates)

# 6. Quick Reference

## Immersion Mode

```
Text: "LOCATION NAME" (2-3 words)
Position: Top center (y < 200px)
Font: 120pt, white, 12px black outline
Logo: Top-left, 100px
Background: NO bars, direct on photo
Colors: Enhanced (sat +20%, contrast +15%)

Variation A: Bright & vibrant
Variation B: Cinematic (golden/cool tint, soft shadow)
Variation C: Dual-text (main + colored subtitle)
```

## Authority Mode (Tutorials)

```
Text: "PROBLEM SOLVED" (2-3 words)
Position: Opposite subject (left or right third)
Font: 100pt, white, 10px outline
Subject: Rule of thirds (left or right)
Arrows: Yellow/red pointing to subject
Colors: High contrast UI elements
```
